style="font-size: 21px;">Index 0 is on the left side team. Index 1 is on the right side team.<br>We compare each index of the left side team with each index of the right side team.<br>We compare the elements at these indices and pick up (copy) the<br>lower value element to the `tempArray`.<br>We start with cLeftIndex = 0 = 51 Vs. cRightIndex = mid + 1&nbsp; = 0 + 1 = 1 = 42.<br>We find that cRightIndex = 1 = 42 is lower than cLeftIndex = 0 = 51.</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;resizeWidth=1;resizeHeight=1;autosize=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="160" y="2024" width="850" height="160" index 1. <br>Hence, we add all the remaining elements of the left side.</b></span>" Index 0 is on the left side team. Index 1 is on the right side team.
We compare each index of the left side team with each index of the right side team.
We compare the elements at these indices and pick up (copy) the
lower value element to the `tempArray`.
We start with cLeftIndex = 0 = 51 Vs. cRightIndex = mid + 1 = 0 + 1 = 1 = 42.
We find that cRightIndex = 1 = 42 is lower than cLeftIndex = 0 = 51.

Index 0, 1, and 2 are on the left side team. Index 3 and 4 are on the right side team.
We compare each index of the left side team with each index of the right side team.
We compare the elements at these indices and pick up (copy) the
lower value element to the `tempArray`.
We start with cLeftIndex = 0 = 33 Vs. cRightIndex = mid + 1 = 2 + 1 = 3 = 15.
We find that cRightIndex = 3 = 15 is lower than cLeftIndex = 0 = 33.
